body.name: Hourglass
body.description: An hourglass filled with sand inside a transparent glass tube. Time is measured by the falling grains.

body.name: Human Remains
body.description: The unidentified remains of a human. Bones lie scattered among filthy soil. Found in the place seen by the leatherworker in his dreams.

body.name: Hunting Trap
body.description: A spring-loaded hunting trap, waiting to snap shut on unsuspecting prey.
body.effect: Set a trap over 6 seconds. When triggered, immediately deal 5 true physical damage and 1 true physical damage per second. Additionally inflict 2 true physical damage with each movement. Effect lasts 3 seconds on players and 7 seconds on monsters, reducing move speed bonus by -40%. The target cannot move beyond a certain radius of the trap.

body.name: Huntress’ Gold Emblem
body.description: An emblem awarded to those who have endured the Huntress’s most arduous assignments. Bearing the radiant brilliance of the sun, this emblem stands as a symbol of an adventurer’s honor and glory.

body.name: Huntress’ Silver Emblem
body.description: An emblem awarded to those who complete the Huntress’s assignments. This silver emblem, gleaming with the cold clarity of moonlight, bears witness to an adventurer’s courage and relentless resolve.

body.name: Icefang
body.description: A blade born of the frozen north, its chilling touch leaves behind frostbitten wounds that are rumored to never thaw.

body.name: Indigo Sash
body.description: An indigo sash cherished by calm adventurers, reflecting a refined and understated elegance.

body.name: Infected Flesh
body.description: A vile piece of flesh, tainted by insidious infection, emanating a nauseating stench.

body.name: Inkwell and Quill Pen
body.description: A small glass inkwell paired with a feather quill. The tip glides smoothly across the page, but the ink easily smudges if left to dry too slowly.

body.name: Intact Skull
body.description: A perfectly preserved skull, devoid of any blemishes.

body.name: Intricate Wooden Figurine
body.description: A small wooden figurine delicately carved by hand. The sculptor's artistic spirit can still be felt.

body.name: Potion of Invisibility
body.description: Become invisible when used. The spell is broken when the target moves or performs an action.
body.effect: Gain invisibility for 11 seconds. When you move, perform an action or take damage, the effect is removed.
